ms.promise:
1. Pentest-Report on "beta smart contract" on Cardano to meet under the Electronic Securities Act (eWpG). Explanation: A penetration test for a smart contract is like a security check to find and fix weak spots in the contract's code before bad people can exploit them. It involves trying to break into the contract in a safe way to see how serious the weak spots are and giving advice on how to make them stronger. This process is very important for keeping the contract and the digital assets it handles safe from attacks.
 
 2. Modify the "beta smart contract" on Cardano to meet under the Electronic Securities Act (eWpG) based on the Pentest-Report.
 
 Clarification to your comments:
 
 1. The is no preaudit of the BaFin. The acceptance of the BaFin regarding the Smart Contract is a tokenization project accepted by the BaFin and published here: https://www.bafin.de/DE/PublikationenDaten/Datenbanken/Kryptowertpapiere/kryptowerte_node.html
ms.criteria:
1. re Pentest-Report: Provide the Pentrest-Report. You can expect 5 pages in writing. Format: PDF.
 
 2. re modification: Provide the code for this modified smart contract in GitHub.

ms.report:
A. Output: Pentest-Report on "beta smart contract" on Cardano
Acceptance criteria: The penetration testing report includes summarized testing criteria and required changes
Evidence: The penetration testing report has been produced two times: the first time to show the findings and the criteria, the second time to ensure suggestions have been implemented or acknowledged. You can find both versions here: https://github.com/FluidTokens/fn-bafin-cardano-sc/tree/main/documents/pentesting
The documents now include the website URL of the auditors as requested by the Catalyst reviewers.

B. Output: Smart contract updated to implement the Pentest-Report findings 
Acceptance criteria: The smart contract code includes suggested improvements, in particular the unit tests.
Evidence: You can find the unit tests, the only strongly suggested improvement to the codebase, here: https://github.com/FluidTokens/fn-bafin-cardano-sc/blob/main/lib/tests.ak
